title: EVA cage pilot labels from real instance data
goal: The Sephirot EVA cage names the pilot and instance that ran each action, from F-049 instance data
acceptance: The EVA cage shows the pilot and EVA instance of a running or finished action from recorded instance data, never a guess
An action with no instance data shows none, distinct from unavailable
A browser test renders both cases
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: Dashboard regression running the real render function; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 in the full audit: the remaining F-051 work named in its next action had no step. Labels only; instance data comes from F-049. Not a measurement.
